# ab_joshactions

Adobe App Builder project containing Adobe I/O Runtime web actions.

## Prerequisites

- [Adobe I/O CLI](https://developer.adobe.com/app-builder/docs/getting_started/) (`npm install -g @adobe/aio-cli`)
- Access to an Adobe App Builder workspace (Adobe Developer Console)
- Node.js 18+

## Setup

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Fill in .env with your values (see below)
aio app deploy
```

## Environment Variables

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in the following values.

### Adobe I/O Runtime (generated by `aio app use`)

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `AIO_runtime_auth` | Runtime auth token in the format `{uuid}:{secret}` |
| `AIO_runtime_namespace` | Your namespace, e.g. `27200-myproject-stage` |
| `AIO_runtime_apihost` | Runtime API host (default: `https://adobeioruntime.net`) |

Run `aio app use` after creating your App Builder project in Adobe Developer Console — it writes these automatically.

### IMS OAuth Server-to-Server Credentials

Used by `frameSendToAEM` to authenticate with both the Frame.io V4 API and the AEM Assets API. Create an OAuth Server-to-Server credential in [Adobe Developer Console](https://developer.adobe.com/console) and add the Frame.io and AEM services.

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `IMS_CLIENT_ID` | OAuth client ID from Adobe Developer Console |
| `IMS_CLIENT_SECRET` | OAuth client secret from Adobe Developer Console |

### Frame.io

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `FRAMEIO_SECRET` | Signing secret from your Frame.io custom action configuration. Found in Frame.io under **Integrations > Custom Actions > your action > Secret**. |

---

## Actions

### `hello`
Simple health-check action. No authentication required.

**URL:** `GET /api/v1/web/joshactions-pkg/hello`

---

### `presignedUrl`
Generates a presigned URL for a file in Adobe I/O Files storage and stores metadata in Adobe I/O State.

**Auth:** Adobe IMS Bearer token required.

---

### `deleteFile`
Deletes a file from Adobe I/O Files storage.

**Auth:** Adobe IMS Bearer token required.

---

### `listFiles`
Lists files in Adobe I/O Files storage.

**Auth:** Adobe IMS Bearer token required.

---

### `getFileProperties`
Returns metadata for a file in Adobe I/O Files storage.

**Auth:** Adobe IMS Bearer token required.

---

### `getAEMPresignedUrl`
Proxies to the AEM `block_download` API and returns a presigned download URL for an AEM asset.

**Auth:** Adobe IMS Bearer token required (forwarded to AEM).

**Params:**
| Param | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | AEM asset URN (e.g. `urn:aaid:aem:...`) |

---

### `frameSendToAEM`
Handles a [Frame.io custom action](https://next.developer.frame.io/platform/v2/index) webhook and uploads the selected asset(s) to AEM Assets.

**Auth:** None (Adobe IMS not required). Requests are verified using HMAC-SHA256 signature from the `x-frameio-signature` header.

**How it works:**

1. Frame.io sends a POST with no `data` field — the action responds with a form asking the user to select an AEM environment and enter a folder path.
2. The user fills out the form and Frame.io sends a second POST containing `data.aem_environment` and `data.aem_folder_path`.
3. The action verifies the signature and immediately responds `200 Success` to Frame.io, then fires a non-blocking async self-invocation to do the real work.
4. In the background, for each resource in the request:
   - Fetches asset details from the Frame.io V4 API (media links + metadata)
   - Imports the original file into AEM Assets via the AEM import-from-URL API, writing `weframeid` and `framelink` as AEM metadata
   - Polls the AEM import job until complete
   - Writes the new AEM asset UUID back to the Frame.io "AEM Asset ID" metadata field
   - Posts a comment on the Frame.io asset with the uploader's name and a direct link to the asset in AEM

**Frame.io custom action setup:**

1. In Frame.io, go to **Integrations > Custom Actions > Create**.
2. Set the **URL** to your deployed action endpoint:
   `https://{namespace}.adobeioruntime.net/api/v1/web/joshactions-pkg/frameSendToAEM`
3. Copy the generated **Secret** into `FRAMEIO_SECRET` in your `.env`.
4. Deploy: `aio app deploy`

**Required `.env` values:** `FRAMEIO_SECRET`, `IMS_CLIENT_ID`, `IMS_CLIENT_SECRET`

**Action timeout:** 120 seconds (configurable in `app.config.yaml`).

---

```bash
aio app deploy
```

```bash
aio app logs
# or

```
